Bound large taxonomy results and preserve user orientation (#819)
* Bound large taxonomy results and preserve user orientation
* Define real responsive viewport and zoom profiles
* Keep only the newest search response authoritative
* Measure real viewport zoom, clipping, and search ordering
* Guard search ordering, clipping, and browser zoom evidence
* Publish confirmed search navigation focus completion
* Wait for confirmed search navigation focus evidence
* Guard observable search navigation focus completion
* Align focus completion source contract with implementation
* Open the complete search workspace before rendering results
* Guard nested search workspace visibility
* Fix large-result workspace source contract
* Measure large-result growth from the complete search workspace
* Skip responsive assertions for scenarios without profile evidence
* Add one-time PR 819 responsive-overflow repair
* Keep search panel gutters within responsive bounds
* Verify responsive search overflow repair
* Complete PR 819 responsive-overflow repair
* Run focused responsive-overflow repair
* Trigger the completed PR 819 overflow repair
* Make the PR 819 repair Python-free
* Trigger the bounded PR 819 repair reliably
* Bound every search form row within the panel
* Trigger exact-head verification after bounded search repair
